page.overview:
What is King Nothing?

King Nothing is the fifth song on Metallica's album Load. It was written by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich, and Kirk Hammett.

The subject matter of King Nothing talks about wanting fame and fortune, and how after a while, it's not what you wanted and it becoming extremely overwhelming.

Wish I may, wish I might Have this I wish tonight Are you satisfied? Dig for gold, dig for fame You dig to make your name Are you pacified?

All the wants you waste All the things you've chased
